title: Man. Post. Cap. VI: PLAC — GAR already grants nature-law; why impute to God?
pass_a_gloss: What in this opinion fights Scripture or right reason? GAR himself in cap. 1 confessed original-vice propagation by nature's law of like begetting like—so he already grants Placeus's truth. Why then, not content, ascribe our original vice to God considering, imputing, and inflicting Adam's actual sin? What necessity made God treat us all as one man in Adam, treat the first actual sin unlike other sins, and impute it to us? One is forced with certain unnamed others to refer the whole to God's will.
pass_b_english: What is there in this my opinion that is not consentaneous either to Scripture or to right reason? You yourself in cap. 1, constituting the state of the question, confessed that the propagation of original vice is done by the law of nature, by which each begets one like himself: you therefore acknowledge the truth of my opinion—what is it that, not content with that, you ascribe the cause of our original vice to God considering Adam's actual sin in a certain way and imputing it to us and inflicting that vice on us? Tell me, I ask, if you can, what necessity there was why God should consider us all as one man in Adam? why he should consider Adam's first actual sin in another way than other sins? why he should impute it to us? You will doubtless be compelled, with certain others whom there is no need to name, to refer that whole thing to God's will.
source_text: Quid est in hac mea sententia quod non sit, aut Scripturae, aut rectae rationi consentaneum? Tu ipse cap. 1. constituendo statum quaestionis fassus es propagationem vitii originis fieri lege naturae, qua quisque sibi similem gignit: agnoscis igitur meae sententiae veritatem: quid est cur ea non contentus causam nostri vitii originalis Deo certo modo peccatum actuale Adami consideranti & imputanti nobis & infligenti nobis illud vitium, imputes? Dic mihi quaeso si potes, quae necessitas fuerit, cur nos omnes Deus consideraret tanquam unum hominem in Adamo? cur primum Adami peccatum actuale consideraret alio modo quam alia peccata? cur id nobis imputaret? cogeris proculdubio cum aliis quibusdam, quos nihil nominare opus est, id universum in Dei voluntatem referre.
